'''2022 Sixth Annual GEMPC''' (Batmouse's 6th GEMPC) was the Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP, January–March 2022. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] defeated [[Mike Kessling]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-gempc-batmouses-6th-gempc/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' January–March 2022
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80594 forum]
